meta.title: Chimney Repair Toronto | Northmark Chimney
meta.description: Chimney repair in Toronto & the GTA: cracked crowns, damaged brick and mortar, leaks, fireboxes and smoke chambers. Free inspection, price before work.

hero.p: Cracked crowns, crumbling mortar, water getting in, a failing firebox or smoke chamber. We show you the damage with photos, tell you what is urgent and what can wait, and give you the price before any work starts.
hero.t-2: Damage shown with photos — before any price is set

signs.p: Most of these are visible from the ground or from inside the house. If you recognise one, it is worth a look.
signs.p-2: Efflorescence — salt left behind as water moves through the masonry. The brick is absorbing water it should be shedding.
signs.h3-2: Brick Or Mortar On The Roof
signs.p-3: Spalling. Water gets into the brick, freezes, expands and pushes the face off. Once it starts it keeps going.
signs.p-4: The concrete slab on top is the chimney’s roof. Once it cracks, water runs straight down inside the structure.
signs.p-5: Mortar wears out before brick. Open joints let water in behind the face of the chimney.
signs.p-6: Water is getting in somewhere above — usually the crown, the cap or the flashing.
signs.h3-6: Rust On The Damper Or Firebox
signs.p-7: Something is letting moisture into the flue. Rust is often the first visible sign.
signs.h3-7: Tiles Or Debris In The Firebox
signs.p-8: The liner may be breaking up. A damaged liner is a safety issue, not a cosmetic one.
signs.p-9: Or a gap between chimney and house. That is structural — stop using the fireplace and call.
signs.p-10: Not sure which one you’re seeing? That is what the free inspection is for. Book it here or call {{site.phone}}.

faq.q: How do I know if my chimney needs repair?
faq.p-2: Debris in the firebox, cracked or flaking brick, white staining, rust, or smoke where it shouldn’t be. The free inspection confirms what is actually going on before you spend anything.
faq.q-2: How much does chimney repair cost?
faq.p-3: It depends entirely on the damage, so we don’t give blind numbers online. The inspection is free and you approve the exact price, at your home, before any work begins.
faq.p-4: Sometimes. Water and freeze-thaw make small cracks grow, so early repair is usually far cheaper. We’ll tell you honestly what is urgent and what can wait.
faq.q-4: Can you match my existing brick and mortar?
faq.p-5: Yes — as closely as possible, especially on older Toronto homes. Matching is part of the job, not an extra.
faq.q-5: Do you repair fireboxes and dampers?
faq.p-6: Yes — firebox mortar joints and panels, and dampers that are stuck, rusted or missing.
